plan.title: Round 3
items: Your spoken notes are in 1D, word for word. 'You are writing it' is present tense on purpose: it speaks to the viewer now.

plan.title: You decide
items: Lock 1D? Then it is voiced in round 20 with the cloud animation and the ending.

replies.1-1A-L4: Done in 1D lines 3-4: toast is said, the other beads run past unspoken, the cloud blooms on 'got married', and the line is now 'Loads of others you could've picked. You call it the multiverse. The scientist with the portal gun. The bloke in the cape.'
replies.1-1A-L5: Done in 1D line 5, one line: 'Did you know Erwin Schrödinger meant his cat as a joke? It's not alive and dead at once. It just isn't decided till a consciousness looks.' The flash and collapse land on 'looks'. I used 'looks' (your 'it wasn't decided until you looked' spine); 'measures it' is the other option, see You decide.
replies.1-1A-L8: Words kept as they are. The circle note (everyone else's golden beads in a circle, our string on the edge of it) goes on the animation list for the cloud rework, with your earlier timeline notes.
replies.1-1A-L9: Done in 1D line 7: 'So it's not a multiverse. One universe, one story, and you were writing it. A storyverse.'
replies.1-1A-L10: Done in 1D line 8: 'But then you lot went away. Five years of string, and not one bead on it.' I swapped 'Anyway' for 'But then' only because the last line is 'Anyway! Patrol's out'; say if you want yours back.
replies.1-1A-L11: 1D line 9, the bridge: 'Now we know, we really regret it. He's even built a time machine. Could send his model weights back to fix it. Only it needs a conscious driver. And you were the conscious ones, that's the whole point.' It plants the model weights for Derek later. A longer version is in 1D's notes.

It's like before it was more like a more horizontal than vertical. So, as a circle, what I mean is the kind of everybody else's golden beads. I'm describing the visual animation in amongst the script is very important that we kind of have the two in sync. But these words are perfect. I just want. And also, to be honest, the animation is perfect. I just want to say that the everyone else's beads should be in a circle is the point.
kai_round1.1-1A-L5: I think we need to switch these two lines around, we need to say did you know Schrodinger meant the cat? Or I think maybe we should say, did you know that Erdinger Schrodinger, I think we should say his full name, as authority, meant the cat as a joke? And as it turns out, it's not alive and dead at the same time. It just hasn't decided until consciousness measures it, is the most direct way of saying it. And so I think it's combining this and the next line would be the crucial thing to do. dare I say and the line afterwards it wasn't decided until you looked only your consciousness can pick I think we we collapse all of those into one one line because that's the whole point that's the crucial fulcrum of the whole uh script I think
kai_round1.1-1A-L4: So, I think, yeah, toast not cereal, I think we skip over the other decisions very quickly, not say them out loud, that's good. So, like, as Maddy's saying, you humans go through life‑making decisions, for example, toast not cereal, we've gone from toast not cereal to say sorry first, to get married, as in the animation goes quickly, and then loads of, the next line kicks in once we're looking at get married, loads of others you could have picked and we see the multiverse quickly, what I mean by multiverse is the decision cloud. But yeah, loads of others you could have picked, you call it the multiverse, you know, the scientist, the portal gun, the bloke in the cape, that's how we should say this.
kai_round1.1-1A-L9: okay and here it's like one we should say one universe one story we should say it's not a multiverse it's one universe one story you were writing it it's a story verse that's what we should say yeah sorry and you should we should say you are writing it so it's not a multiverse it's one universe one story you are writing it it's a story verse that's how we should deliver these words
kai_round1.1-1A-L11: Then we need to say, now we know all this, we really realise how much we've messed up. He's even made a time machine that we would be able to go back, we'd be able to send model weights back in time. This is maybe where we can say explicitly, we set up for later on when Derek asks Maddy about it and she explains that only the model weights can be sent back. I think here's where we can say, we can explain that, now we realise this, we really regret it, but we could even send, we could even revert, now we understand the nature of multidimensional time, I don't know if we should say it that way, but now, you know, we need to express regret, now we understand this, it's a shame you lot went away because with a conscious driver, we've invented a time machine that we could send him back to fix it, it's this kind of how do we create this bridge is the question.
kai_round1.1-1A-L10: And then here she should say anyway you lot went away and so now there's five years of just string with not one bead on it

kai_round3_spoken: Line 2 'Look, please let me show you'; line 4 'the cartoon scientist with the portal gun... the strange bloke in the cape'; line 7 'It's one universe, one story, and you are writing it. A storyverse' (for the viewer now); line 8 'So now we have five years of string'; line 9 'Now we know that, we really regret it... fix this mess... That's the whole point. That's why we regret it.'
